target_customer: Consumers and device makers (AR/VR, AI assistants) who want hands-free control by thought; originally a wearable brain-recording device
problem: Interacting with computers needs hands, voice or screens. MindPortal built non-invasive optical brain interface technology, later framed as AI models that decode imagined speech into text.
business_model: Deep-tech R&D; no sourced revenue model
product_category: Non-invasive brain-computer interface and thought-to-text AI models

founders.name: Ekram Alam
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder and CEO in the PR Newswire seed release and on the YC page; no background given.

founders.name: Jack Baber
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as co-founder; Welcome to the Jungle lists him as co-founder and CTO.

technical_complexity.rationale: Decoding brain signals non-invasively with optical sensing is research-grade; the 2021 release claimed 10 to 100x EEG precision, unverified.

defensibility.rationale: Patent-pending wearable per the May 2021 release; a trademark for MINDPORTAL was filed July 2021. Little evidence of external validation.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying MindPortal.

market_need_then: Interest in brain-computer interfaces was growing in 2021 (UKTN framed MindPortal as a London Neuralink rival). No customer demand data found.

branding.domain_note: Uses mindportal.com; no acquisition story found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Bold claims such as 'First Telepathic AI Company'

branding.brand_signature: Telepathic AI positioning and the 2023 to 2024 demo of chatting with ChatGPT by thought
branding.community_and_virality: Press coverage of the Matt Bellamy backed seed (2021) and the MindGPT telepathy demo (2023 to 2024 outlets such as Psychology Today and App Developer Magazine).

brand_strength.rationale: Evocative name and eye-catching celebrity backing and demos earned press, though claims are the company's own.

outcome_analysis: MindPortal raised a $5M seed in May 2021 led by Learn Capital with celebrity and Kleiner Perkins backing, and later reframed itself around thought-to-text AI models (MindSpeech, MindGPT, MindClick). YC lists it inactive, but its own site presents it as operating and says less than $6M has been spent by a team of up to 10, so the status is unresolved and no shutdown cause is public.
notes: Status conflict: YC says Inactive while the company site and 2023 to 2024 coverage show activity; exit left unknown. The $20M valuation is from UKTN (snippet), sources conflict on whether the round was $3.5M (UKTN headline) or $5M (press release); recorded the press release. An additional $125K seed round appears only on thecompanycheck, a single aggregator, undated, not recorded as a round. CB Insights total $5.13M. A single aggregator names Kernel as rival (undated), so no dated competitors recorded. Location conflicts between London and San Francisco.
